import { computed, reactive, shallowRef, watch, nextTick } from 'vue';
import { createRouter, createMemoryHistory } from 'vue-router';
import { createNavigation } from '../navigation/Navigation.js';
import { receiptKey } from './Data.js';
/** 本地合成读取/核验，没有任何业务写入；导航真实使用原032模块。 */
export function createSuccessFixture(locale, components) {
	const controls = reactive({
		owner: 'reader-a',
		scope: 'synthetic-east',
		revision: 1,
		disabled: false,
		readonly: false,
		denied: false,
		invalidId: false,
		mode: 'success',
		delayMs: 80,
		recovery: 'confirmed',
		navigation: 'normal'
	});
	const audit = reactive({
		reads: 0,
		verifies: 0,
		navigations: 0,
		aborted: 0,
		writes: 0,
		readerVersion: 1,
		actions: 0
	});
	const lastReceipt = shallowRef(),
		destinationReceipt = shallowRef();
	let disposed = false,
		navEpoch = 0;
	const pending = new Set();
	const identity = computed(() => ({
		id: controls.invalidId ? '' : 'synthetic-receipt-018',
		route: '/result/success',
		owner: controls.owner,
		scope: controls.scope,
		revision: controls.revision
	}));
	const validIdentity = (input) => {
		try {
			return (
				!disposed && !controls.denied && receiptKey(input) === receiptKey(identity.value)
			);
		} catch {
			return false;
		}
	};
	const wait = (signal, ms) =>
		new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
			let done = false;
			const finish = (abort) => {
				if (done) return;
				done = true;
				clearTimeout(timer);
				signal.removeEventListener('abort', cancel);
				pending.delete(cancel);
				if (abort) {
					audit.aborted++;
					reject(new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError'));
				} else resolve();
			};
			const cancel = () => finish(true),
				timer = setTimeout(() => finish(false), ms);
			pending.add(cancel);
			if (signal.aborted || disposed) cancel();
			else signal.addEventListener('abort', cancel, { once: true });
		});
	let activeNavigation;
	const router = createRouter({
		history: createMemoryHistory(),
		routes: [
			{ path: '/', redirect: '/result/success' },
			{ path: '/result/success', component: components.scene }
		]
	});
	const navigation = createNavigation({
		router,
		components: { workspace: components.destination, application: components.destination },
		fallback: '/result/success',
		scope: 'synthetic-result-navigation',
		load: async () =>
			controls.denied
				? []
				: [
						{
							id: 'workspace',
							path: '/local/workspace',
							title: '本地工作空间',
							resource: 'workspace',
							cache: false
						},
						{
							id: 'application',
							path: '/local/application',
							title: '本地申请对象',
							resource: 'application',
							cache: false
						}
					],
		confirm: async () => {
			const own = activeNavigation;
			await nextTick();
			return (
				!own ||
				(!own.signal.aborted &&
					own.ticket === navEpoch &&
					validIdentity(own.input) &&
					!controls.disabled &&
					!controls.readonly &&
					controls.navigation !== 'cancel')
			);
		}
	});
	const initialized = shallowRef(false),
		services = shallowRef();
	function makeServices() {
		return {
			async read(request) {
				audit.reads++;
				const mode = controls.mode,
					english = request.locale === 'en',
					t = (zh, en) => (english ? en : zh);
				await wait(request.signal, mode === 'timeout' ? 2000 : controls.delayMs);
				if (!request.isCurrent() || !validIdentity(request))
					throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
				if (mode === 'error') throw Error('PRIVATE_SYNTHETIC_RECEIPT_ERROR_NOT_FOR_UI');
				if (mode === 'empty') return { status: 'empty' };
				const who = {
					id: request.id,
					route: request.route,
					owner: request.owner,
					scope: request.scope,
					revision: request.revision
				};
				const common = { ...who, returnTarget: 'workspace', nextTarget: 'application' };
				if (mode === 'unknown' || mode === 'failed') {
					lastReceipt.value = undefined;
					return {
						status: 'ready',
						snapshot: {
							input: {
								...common,
								kind: 'failure',
								writeState: mode === 'unknown' ? 'unknown' : 'failed'
							}
						}
					};
				}
				const receipt = {
					identity: who,
					subject:
						mode === 'long'
							? t(
									'研发测试设备采购及多团队长周期测试环境能力扩展项目',
									'Development testing equipment purchase and long-term multi-team environment expansion'
								)
							: t('研发测试设备采购', 'Development test equipment purchase'),
					number: 'SQ-20261030-018',
					applicant:
						request.owner === 'reader-a'
							? t('林岚', 'Lin Lan')
							: t('周远', 'Zhou Yuan'),
					amountCents: mode === 'partial' ? null : mode === 'zero' ? 0 : 2468000,
					submittedAt: '2026-10-30T14:30:00+08:00',
					provenance: 'synthetic',
					steps: [
						{
							id: 'submitted',
							title: t('提交申请', 'Submit application'),
							state: 'done'
						},
						{
							id: 'department',
							title: t('部门审批', 'Department approval'),
							state: 'current'
						},
						{
							id: 'purchase',
							title: t('采购处理', 'Procurement processing'),
							state: 'waiting'
						}
					]
				};
				lastReceipt.value = receipt;
				return {
					status: 'ready',
					snapshot: {
						input: {
							...common,
							kind: 'success',
							confirmed: true,
							title: t('申请提交成功', 'Application submitted'),
							description: t(
								'本地合成申请已进入演示审批流程，可以查看演示进展。',
								'The local synthetic application has entered the demo workflow. View its demo progress.'
							)
						},
						receipt
					}
				};
			}
		};
	}
	services.value = makeServices();
	const resultHost = computed(() => {
		const recovery = controls.recovery;
		return {
			fallback: 'workspace',
			allows: (target) =>
				!disposed &&
				!controls.denied &&
				['workspace', 'application'].includes(target) &&
				navigation.menu.value.some((item) => item.id === target),
			async navigate(target, context) {
				if (
					!validIdentity(context) ||
					context.signal.aborted ||
					controls.disabled ||
					controls.readonly ||
					context.route !== router.currentRoute.value.fullPath
				)
					return false;
				const ticket = ++navEpoch;
				await wait(context.signal, controls.delayMs);
				if (!validIdentity(context) || context.signal.aborted || ticket !== navEpoch)
					return false;
				if (controls.navigation === 'error')
					throw Error('PRIVATE_SYNTHETIC_NAVIGATION_ERROR');
				if (controls.navigation === 'cancel') return false;
				activeNavigation = { ticket, input: context, signal: context.signal };
				destinationReceipt.value = lastReceipt.value;
				try {
					const accepted = await navigation.navigate(navigation.location(target));
					if (accepted && validIdentity(context)) audit.navigations++;
					return accepted;
				} finally {
					if (activeNavigation?.ticket === ticket) activeNavigation = undefined;
				}
			},
			recovery: {
				operation: 'verify',
				async run(context) {
					audit.verifies++;
					await wait(context.signal, recovery === 'late' ? 2000 : controls.delayMs);
					if (!validIdentity(context) || context.signal.aborted)
						throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
					if (recovery === 'error') throw Error('PRIVATE_SYNTHETIC_RECOVERY_ERROR');
					return recovery === 'denied'
						? { status: 'denied' }
						: recovery === 'failed'
							? { status: 'still-failed' }
							: { status: 'confirmed' };
				}
			}
		};
	});
	const readHost = computed(() => ({
		identity: identity.value,
		allowed:
			initialized.value &&
			!controls.denied &&
			router.currentRoute.value.path === '/result/success',
		disabled: controls.disabled,
		readonly: controls.readonly,
		timeoutMs: controls.mode === 'timeout' ? 120 : 5000,
		services: services.value,
		resultHost: resultHost.value
	}));
	const stop = watch(
		[
			() => controls.owner,
			() => controls.scope,
			() => controls.revision,
			() => controls.denied,
			() => controls.invalidId
		],
		() => {
			navEpoch++;
			activeNavigation = undefined;
			lastReceipt.value = undefined;
			destinationReceipt.value = undefined;
			if (initialized.value) {
				void router.replace('/result/success');
				void navigation.reload(controls.scope);
			}
		},
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	const stopMode = watch(
		() => controls.mode,
		() => controls.revision++,
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	return {
		controls,
		audit,
		identity,
		readHost,
		resultHost,
		router,
		navigation,
		destinationReceipt,
		actionStarted() {
			audit.actions++;
		},
		update(key, value) {
			controls[key] = value;
		},
		async initialize() {
			await router.replace('/result/success');
			await router.isReady();
			if (!(await navigation.reload())) throw Error('Local navigation unavailable');
			initialized.value = true;
		},
		async back() {
			activeNavigation = undefined;
			await router.replace('/result/success');
		},
		replaceReader() {
			audit.readerVersion++;
			services.value = makeServices();
		},
		dispose() {
			if (disposed) return;
			disposed = true;
			stop();
			stopMode();
			navEpoch++;
			for (const cancel of [...pending]) cancel();
			navigation.dispose();
			lastReceipt.value = undefined;
			destinationReceipt.value = undefined;
		}
	};
}

import { computed, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { createAsamDataRuntime } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { receiptKey } from './Data.js';
/** 只读取初始回执；恢复、unknown与导航仍由原ResultController/030负责。 */
export function createReceiptReader(getHost, locale, decode) {
	const runtime = createAsamDataRuntime({ scope: 'success-receipt-initial' }),
		snapshot = shallowRef(),
		status = shallowRef('idle'),
		error = shallowRef('');
	let disposed = false,
		generation = 0,
		timer,
		cancelPending;
	const canRead = () => !disposed && getHost().allowed && !getHost().disabled;
	const keyOfHost = () => {
		try {
			return receiptKey(getHost().identity);
		} catch {
			return undefined;
		}
	};
	function cancel() {
		generation++;
		const pending = cancelPending;
		cancelPending = undefined;
		pending?.();
		if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
		timer = undefined;
		runtime.invalidate();
		if (status.value === 'loading') status.value = 'idle';
	}
	async function refresh() {
		cancel();
		snapshot.value = undefined;
		error.value = '';
		if (!canRead()) {
			status.value = getHost().allowed ? 'idle' : 'forbidden';
			return;
		}
		const host = getHost(),
			key = keyOfHost();
		if (!key) {
			status.value = 'error';
			error.value = 'invalid';
			return;
		}
		if (runtime.scope !== key) runtime.setScope(key);
		const own = ++generation,
			context = runtime.createContext();
		status.value = 'loading';
		const current = () =>
			!disposed &&
			own === generation &&
			getHost().allowed &&
			!getHost().disabled &&
			keyOfHost() === key &&
			getHost().services === host.services;
		const isCurrent = () => current() && runtime.isCurrent(context);
		let timeout,
			ownCancel,
			timedOut = false,
			decoding = false;
		try {
			const deadline =
				typeof host.timeoutMs === 'number' &&
				Number.isFinite(host.timeoutMs) &&
				host.timeoutMs > 0
					? host.timeoutMs
					: 5000;
			const aborted = new Promise((_resolve, reject) => {
				ownCancel = () => reject(new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError'));
				cancelPending = ownCancel;
			});
			const deadlineRead = new Promise((_resolve, reject) => {
				timeout = setTimeout(() => {
					timedOut = true;
					runtime.release(context);
					reject(Error('Receipt timeout'));
				}, deadline);
				timer = timeout;
			});
			const result = await Promise.race([
				Promise.resolve().then(() => {
					if (!isCurrent()) throw new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError');
					return host.services.read({
						...host.identity,
						locale: locale(),
						signal: context.signal,
						isCurrent
					});
				}),
				deadlineRead,
				aborted
			]);
			if (!isCurrent()) return;
			if (result.status === 'ready') {
				decoding = true;
				snapshot.value = decode(result.snapshot, host.identity);
				status.value = 'ready';
			} else status.value = result.status;
		} catch {
			if (current()) {
				snapshot.value = undefined;
				status.value = 'error';
				error.value = timedOut ? 'timeout' : decoding ? 'invalid' : 'read';
			}
		} finally {
			if (timeout) clearTimeout(timeout);
			if (timer === timeout) timer = undefined;
			if (cancelPending === ownCancel) cancelPending = undefined;
			runtime.release(context);
		}
	}
	const stop = watch(
		[
			() => getHost().identity.id,
			() => getHost().identity.route,
			() => getHost().identity.owner,
			() => getHost().identity.scope,
			() => getHost().identity.revision,
			() => getHost().services,
			() => getHost().allowed,
			locale
		],
		() => {
			cancel();
			snapshot.value = undefined;
			status.value = getHost().allowed ? 'idle' : 'forbidden';
			if (canRead()) void refresh();
		},
		{ flush: 'sync', immediate: true }
	);
	const stopDisabled = watch(
		() => getHost().disabled,
		(value) => {
			if (value) cancel();
			else if (!snapshot.value && canRead()) void refresh();
		},
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	const input = computed(() =>
		snapshot.value
			? {
					...snapshot.value.input,
					disabled: !!getHost().disabled || !!snapshot.value.input.disabled,
					readonly: !!getHost().readonly || !!snapshot.value.input.readonly
				}
			: undefined
	);
	return {
		snapshot,
		status,
		error,
		input,
		canRead: computed(canRead),
		refresh,
		cancel,
		dispose() {
			if (disposed) return;
			disposed = true;
			stop();
			stopDisabled();
			cancel();
			snapshot.value = undefined;
		}
	};
}

<template>
	<section
		ref="element"
		class="success-receipt"
		:aria-label="i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptSummary')"
	>
		<AsamDescriptions
			:key="columns"
			:column="columns"
			direction="vertical"
			class="success-summary"
			><AsamDescriptionsItem :label="i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptSubject')"
				><span data-receipt-field="subject">{{

			><AsamDescriptionsItem

			><AsamDescriptionsItem :label="i18n.t('app.templates.results.receiptAmount')"
				><span data-receipt-field="amount">{{ money }}</span></AsamDescriptionsItem
			></AsamDescriptions
		><slot :narrow="narrow" />
		<p class="receipt-provenance" data-receipt-provenance>
			{{
				receipt.provenance === 'synthetic'

							'本地合成回执，未向真实审批或采购服务提交。',
							'Local synthetic receipt. Nothing was submitted to a live approval or procurement service.'
						)
					: text(
							'宿主已明确确认的回执；业务事实由宿主提供。',

						)
			}}
		</p>
	</section>

<script setup>
import { computed, onMounted, onBeforeUnmount, ref, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamDescriptions, AsamDescriptionsItem } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { formatReceiptCents } from './Data.js';
import { useTemplateI18n } from '../i18n/index.js';
const props = defineProps({
		receipt: { type: Object, required: true }
	}),
	i18n = useTemplateI18n();
const text = (zh, en) => (i18n.locale.value === 'en' ? en : zh);
const element = ref(),
	narrow = shallowRef(false);
const money = computed(() => formatReceiptCents(props.receipt.amountCents, i18n.locale.value));
const columns = computed(() => (narrow.value ? 1 : props.receipt.submittedAt ? 3 : 2));
const submissionTime = computed(() =>
	props.receipt.submittedAt
		? new Intl.DateTimeFormat(i18n.locale.value, {
				dateStyle: 'medium',
				timeStyle: 'short'

		: ''
);
let observer;
onMounted(() => {
	observer = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => {
		if (entry) narrow.value = entry.contentRect.width < 640;
	});
	if (element.value) observer.observe(element.value);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => observer?.disconnect());
</script>

import { computed, onBeforeUnmount } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamSkeleton, AsamResult } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { createReceiptRead } from './State.js';
import SuccessResultPage from './SuccessResultPage.vue';

		size: { type: String, required: false },
		theme: { type: String, required: false }
	}),
	i18n = useTemplateI18n(),
	text = (zh, en) => (i18n.locale.value === 'en' ? en : zh);
const state = createReceiptRead(
		() => props.fixture.readHost.value,
		() => i18n.locale.value
	),
	input = state.input;
const statusTitle = computed(() =>
	state.status.value === 'forbidden'
		? text('无权读取回执', 'Receipt access denied')
		: state.status.value === 'error'
			? text('暂时无法读取回执', 'Receipt unavailable')
			: state.status.value === 'empty'
				? text('暂无回执', 'No receipt')
				: text('等待读取回执', 'Awaiting receipt read')
);
const statusDescription = computed(() =>
	state.error.value === 'timeout'
		? text(
				'读取已超时，原结果未改变，请显式刷新重试。',
				'The read timed out. The original result is unchanged; refresh to retry.'
			)
		: state.error.value === 'invalid'
			? text(
					'回执与当前身份或格式不匹配，未展示原始数据。',
					'The receipt does not match the current identity or format. No raw data is displayed.'
				)
			: state.status.value === 'error'
				? text(
						'本次读取失败，原业务结果未改变。',
						'This read failed. The original business result is unchanged.'
					)
				: text(
						'仅展示当前合法宿主提供的回执，不推断业务是否成功。',
						'Only receipt data from the current permitted host is displayed. No business outcome is inferred.'
					)
);
onBeforeUnmount(state.dispose);
</script>

<template>
	<section class="success-result-page" data-success-page>
		<h1 class="receipt-sr">{{ text('申请结果', 'Application result') }}</h1>
		<MinimalResultPage
			:input="input"
			:host="host"
			:size="size"
			:theme="theme"
			:print-receipt="openPreview"
			@start="emit('start', $event)"
			@success="emit('success', $event)"
			@failure="(id, error) => emit('failure', id, error)"
			><template v-if="validReceipt" #receipt
				><ReceiptContent :receipt="validReceipt" /></template></MinimalResultPage
		><AsamDialog
			class="success-receipt-preview"
			append-to-body
			:model-value="!!preview"
			:title="text('打印回执预览', 'Receipt print preview')"
			width="min(760px,calc(100vw - 32px))"
			@update:model-value="closePreview"
			><section v-if="preview" data-success-print-document>
				<h2>{{ preview.input.title || text('申请提交成功', 'Application submitted') }}</h2>
				<p>{{ preview.input.description }}</p>
				<ReceiptContent :receipt="preview.receipt" />
			</section>
			<template #footer
				><AsamButton @click="closePreview(false)" type="primary">{{
					text('关闭', 'Close')
				}}</AsamButton
				><AsamButton
					type="primary"
					:disabled="!preview || disabledPrint"
					@click="printPreview"
					>{{ text('浏览器打印预览', 'Browser print preview') }}</AsamButton
				></template
			></AsamDialog
		>
	</section>
</template>
<script setup>
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamDialog, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import MinimalResultPage from '../families/MinimalResultPage.vue';
import { useTemplateI18n } from '../i18n/index.js';
import { receiptKey, receiptMatches } from './Data.js';
import ReceiptContent from './ReceiptContent.vue';
const props = defineProps({
	input: { type: Object, required: true },
	host: { type: Object, required: true },
	receipt: { type: Object, required: false },
	size: { type: String, required: false },
	theme: { type: String, required: false }
});
const emit = defineEmits(['start', 'success', 'failure']),
	i18n = useTemplateI18n(),
	text = (zh, en) => (i18n.locale.value === 'en' ? en : zh);
const preview = shallowRef();
const validReceipt = computed(() =>
	props.input.kind === 'success' &&
	props.input.confirmed &&
	receiptMatches(props.receipt, props.input)
		? props.receipt
		: undefined
);
const disabledPrint = computed(() => !!props.input.disabled || !!props.input.readonly);
function openPreview(input) {
	if (!validReceipt.value || disabledPrint.value || receiptKey(input) !== receiptKey(props.input))
		return;
	preview.value = { input: Object.freeze({ ...input }), receipt: validReceipt.value };
}
function closePreview(value) {
	if (value === false) preview.value = undefined;
}
function printPreview() {
	if (
		preview.value &&
		!disabledPrint.value &&
		validReceipt.value === preview.value.receipt &&
		receiptKey(preview.value.input) === receiptKey(props.input)
	)
		window.print();
}
watch(
	[
		() => props.input,
		() => props.host,
		() => props.receipt,
		() => receiptKey(props.input),
		() => props.input.disabled,
		() => props.input.readonly
	],
	() => {
		preview.value = undefined;
	},
	{ flush: 'sync' }
);
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	preview.value = undefined;
});
</script>

import { createApp, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamI18nKey, createAsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import App from './App.vue';
import Scene from './Scene.vue';
import Destination from './Destination.vue';
import { createSuccessFixture } from './Fixture.js';
export async function mountSuccessResult(element, host, onError) {
	const locale = shallowRef('zh-CN'),
		i18n = host?.i18n ?? createAsamI18n(() => ({ locale: locale.value }));
	const fixture = createSuccessFixture(() => i18n.locale.value, {
		scene: Scene,
		destination: Destination
	});
	const app = createApp(App, {
		fixture,
		externalI18n: host?.i18n,
		inheritAppearance: host?.inheritAppearance,
		diagnostics: host?.diagnostics,
		onLocale: (value) => {
			locale.value = value;
		}
	});
	app.provide(AsamI18nKey, i18n);
	provideAsamData(app, {}, { scope: 'success-result-demo' });
	app.use(fixture.router);
	if (onError) app.config.errorHandler = onError;
	try {
		await fixture.initialize();
		app.mount(element);
	} catch (error) {
		fixture.dispose();
		if (!host?.i18n) i18n.dispose();
		throw error;
	}
	let disposed = false;
	return () => {
		if (disposed) return;
		disposed = true;
		app.unmount();
		fixture.dispose();
		if (!host?.i18n) i18n.dispose();
	};
}

import { useTemplateI18n } from './i18n/index.js';
import { computed, nextTick, onScopeDispose, shallowRef, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamException, AsamStatePanel } from '@asam-ui/pro/components';
import { createResultController } from './Controller.js';
export function useResultPage(props, emit = () => {}) {
	const i18n = useTemplateI18n();
	const copy = computed(() => ({
		success: {
			title: i18n.t('app.templates.results.submissionComplete'),
			description: i18n.t('app.templates.results.theHostConfirmedTheResultViewTheRecordOr'),
			code: i18n.t('app.templates.results.complete'),
			tone: 'success'
		},
		failure: {
			title: i18n.t('app.templates.results.theOperationDidNotComplete'),
			description: i18n.t(
				'app.templates.results.verifyTheLatestResultBeforeDecidingWhatToDo'
			),
			code: i18n.t('app.templates.results.needsAttention'),
			tone: 'warning'
		},
		forbidden: {
			title: i18n.t('app.templates.results.thisPageIsCurrentlyUnavailableToYou'),
			description: i18n.t('app.templates.results.youDoNotHaveAccessToThisResourceRead'),
			code: '403',
			tone: 'warning'
		},
		'not-found': {
			title: i18n.t('app.templates.results.pageNotFound'),
			description: i18n.t('app.templates.results.theAddressMayHaveChangedCheckThePathOr'),
			code: '404',
			tone: 'info'
		},
		'server-error': {
			title: i18n.t('app.templates.results.theServiceIsTemporarilyUnavailable'),
			description: i18n.t('app.templates.results.noResultWasReceivedReadTheStatusAgainOr'),
			code: '500',
			tone: 'error'
		}
	}));
	const controller = createResultController(props.input, props.host);
	// 只跟随 030 公开事件固定 actions 身份，按钮 pending/disabled/aria-busy 仍全部由 030 管理。
	const executing = shallowRef(false);
	const generation = shallowRef(0);
	let disposed = false;
	const stateKey = computed(() =>
		JSON.stringify([
			props.input.id,
			props.input.kind,
			props.input.route,
			props.input.owner,
			props.input.scope,
			props.input.revision,
			props.input.disabled,
			props.input.readonly
		])
	);
	watch(
		() => [stateKey.value, props.input, props.host],
		() => {
			generation.value++;
			executing.value = false;
			controller.replace(props.input, props.host);
		},
		{ flush: 'sync' }
	);
	onScopeDispose(() => {
		disposed = true;
		generation.value++;
		controller.dispose();
	});
	function start(id) {
		executing.value = true;
		emit('start', id);
	}
	function success(id) {
		// 此时 030 已完成本次执行。先释放，再通知宿主，允许回调同步启动下一次动作。
		executing.value = false;
		emit('success', id);
	}
	function failure(id, error) {
		executing.value = false;
		emit('failure', id, error);
	}
	const verified = computed(
		() => props.input.kind !== 'success' || props.input.confirmed === true
	);
	const content = computed(() => ({
		...copy.value[props.input.kind],
		title: verified.value
			? props.input.title || copy.value[props.input.kind].title
			: i18n.t('app.templates.results.resultNotYetConfirmed'),
		description: verified.value
			? props.input.description || copy.value[props.input.kind].description
			: i18n.t('app.templates.results.waitForTheHostToConfirmTheBusinessResult'),
		tone: verified.value ? copy.value[props.input.kind].tone : 'info'
	}));
	const actions = computed((previous) => {
		const own = generation.value;
		// feedback 已结算不代表 030 的 await 已结算；直到其真实终结事件才更新动作列表。
		if (executing.value && previous) return previous;
		const run = (action) => async () => {
			// start 回调可以同步替换输入/卸载；先让 Vue 提交这些变更，再核本动作身份。
			await nextTick();
			if (!disposed && own === generation.value) await action();
		};
		const list = [];
		if (
			props.host.recovery &&
			['failure', 'server-error', 'forbidden'].includes(props.input.kind)
		)
			list.push({
				id: 'recover',
				get label() {
					return props.input.kind === 'forbidden'
						? i18n.t('app.templates.results.readPermissionsAgain')
						: i18n.t('app.templates.results.verifyAgain');
				},
				run: run(controller.recover)
			});
		if (
			props.input.nextTarget &&
			props.host.allows(props.input.nextTarget) &&
			((props.input.kind === 'success' && verified.value) ||
				(['failure', 'server-error'].includes(props.input.kind) &&
					controller.feedback.value.phase === 'confirmed'))
		)
			list.push({
				id: 'next',
				get label() {
					return i18n.t('app.templates.results.viewRecord');
				},
				run: run(() => controller.go('next'))
			});
		list.push({
			id: 'return',
			get label() {
				return i18n.t('app.templates.results.returnToWorkspace');
			},
			run: run(() => controller.go('return'))
		});
		return list;
	});
	const panel = computed(() => (props.input.kind === 'success' ? AsamStatePanel : AsamException));
	const path = computed(() =>
		props.input.kind === 'not-found' ? props.input.unknownPath.slice(0, 160) : ''
	);
	const correlation = computed(() => props.input.correlationId?.slice(0, 80) || '');
	return {
		content,
		actions,
		panel,
		path,
		correlation,
		stateKey,
		feedback: computed(() => ({
			...controller.feedback.value,
			message: controller.formatMessage?.(i18n) ?? controller.feedback.value.message
		})),
		start,
		success,
		failure
	};
}

成功结果页包含同源四字段回执、三步进展、查看申请与打印内容区。桌面横向、窄屏纵向，金额使用CNY整数分；未知金额显示—，零金额保留0.00。

宿主和业务结果

SuccessReadHost只读取当前身份的初始回执，ResultHost沿用原结果控制器与安全导航。只有明确confirmed:true或标识清楚的本地合成适配器可呈现成功。unknown核验只提供反馈，不修改原结果、不重发原写。身份、scope、revision、读取器替换、取消、超时和卸载均隔离迟到结果。

查看与打印

查看申请沿原032 allowlist进入本地登记的对象，安全返回保留。打印回执先打开真实AsamDialog内容预览，再由用户打开浏览器打印预览；只打印同一份回执内容，关闭、取消或重复打开不改变业务结果。没有真实审批、采购接口或后台连接。

源码与正常工程

TS/JS展示、复制、源码ZIP及完整工程来自同一中央公开投影。完整工程包含固定正常包、pnpm锁和必要补丁；JS checkJs=false，严格模板。旧results三族与原/pro/v2-044.html默认入口保持。

本页内容
